title: Official languages: Oceania
intro: Pick an official language of each country in Oceania.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of Fiji?
questions.explain: Fiji Hindi is an official language of Fiji.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of New Zealand?
questions.explain: Maori is an official language of New Zealand.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of Papua New Guinea?
questions.explain: Tok Pisin is an official language of Papua New Guinea.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of Marshall Islands?
questions.explain: English is an official language of Marshall Islands.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of Naoero?
questions.explain: English is an official language of Naoero.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of Samoa?
questions.explain: Samoan is an official language of Samoa.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of Kiribati?

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of Solomon Islands?
questions.explain: English is an official language of Solomon Islands.
